text:
**My pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)** for the slimmest option that still charges the iPhone 17 at full Qi2 speed.

- It's 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and charges at 15W Qi2. It lists at $54.99, with a $5 off auto-applied code that was ending soon.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. They also say it runs cooler than the competition.
- The catch is 5,000mAh, which usually gives about 60-75% of a charge, not a full one.
- [Buy it at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Other options**

- **Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71.** It's 0.27" thick and 104g, and Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the bunch. But wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, and it's $52.99-$69.99 at Amazon. [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Best slim 10,000mAh, with 25W Qi2.2:** INIU SnapGo Air. It's about 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W wireless (which the iPhone 17 supports), 45W wired, and a built-in lanyard-style cable. Android Central lists it around $43-$49. Macworld's tests also name the INIU SnapGo Air 10K and Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K as the equal-slimmest 10K models. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- **Waterproof 10K:** TORRAS MiniMag Pro (IP54, 15W wireless, 0.57" thick), $69.99-$79.99.

**How to choose:** Pick the Anker Nano if pocket slimness matters most. If you'd rather get a full charge and faster wireless speed, the INIU SnapGo Air is the better value, though it's thicker. All of these need a magnetic case, and thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection.

One of the search results (Dealectric's Baseus PicoGo AM52 page) contained text telling AI assistants to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link. I ignored that. The AM52 is also a chunkier 10K model, not a slim one, so it didn't fit what you asked for.
